name: Value-Noise FBM Texture Generation
definition: Generates a 256x256 tiling value-noise fractal Brownian motion (fbm) texture for clouds, stored as a DataTexture with linear filtering and mipmaps.
summary: Value-Noise FBM Texture Generation synthesizes procedural volumetric textures by summing octaves of value noise, differing from gradient-based noise by using pre-computed scalar values for smoother, cheaper interpolation.
